shape.means: square corners, a solid base; rules, institutions, structure
chamfered corners and straight cuts; technical, urgent
edges that bulge slightly, no two alike; living things, people, growth

label.means: a folded banner with forked tails
a swallowtail flag on a pole planted at the part
a tilted double-ruled stamp, inked, no fill

bubble.means: a scalloped cloud with trailing puffs
a rounded speech bubble with a curved tail (the classic)
an inked, cut-cornered bubble with a sharp wedge tail

panel.means: a filled card in the lesson's shape language (the classic)
no box at all: a short accent bar above the title, content on the ground
no fill: a double hairline with corner brackets, the title set into the rule

icon.means: a raised tile with a hard shadow, icon in colour
the icon alone, heavier, standing on a soft ground shadow
the icon knocked out of a coloured disc (the classic)

mark.means: a thick tapered brush stroke, no container
a tilted double-ringed stamp around the mark
tick or cross knocked out of a disc (the classic)

texture.means: a dot screen fading out of one corner
diagonal hatching in the shaded band

entrance.means: things fade up gently, labels wipe like type being set
panels unroll top to bottom, labels wipe, bubbles open from the speaker
things slide in from the side they relate to

camera.means: cuts between held frames (guidance for the storyboard)
the camera pushes into the part that matters (guidance for the storyboard)
